name: Rivers and Mountains Quiz
description: Eleven questions about famous rivers and mountains around the world.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eleven multiple-choice questions about famous rivers and mountains, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer what you like; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
A short explanation follows each answer.
Press Next question to carry on.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: Heights are rounded, so treat them as good estimates.
